Typical stage timing (approximate days from planting):
- germination: 0-7 days (seeds sprouting)
- seedling: 7-21 days (small leaves, delicate stem)
- vegetative: 21-60 days (leaf and stem growth, no flowers/fruit)
- flowering: 60-90 days (flowers appearing)
- fruiting: 90-120 days (fruit developing)
- mature: 120+ days (ready for harvest)

Consider:
- Fast-growing plants (leafy_greens, herbs) may reach maturity faster
- Fruiting plants (fruiting_nightshade, vines) go through all stages
- Trees (category: tree) take longer in each stage
- Perennials like citrus and succulents have extended cycles
